image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) adhering to a wet, rocky substrate surrounded by small barnacles. The chiton has an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal shell composed of overlapping plates embedded in a textured girdle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is reduced without eyes or tentacles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The anterior end of the organism is visible and blunt; there are no protruding eyes, stalks, or tentacles, consistent with chiton anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Anterior end is blunt and indistinct.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front edge of the animal blends smoothly into the girdle without sharp definition or specialized head structures.
The surface appears uniform without antennae or sensory appendages.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dorsal surface protected by eight overlapping calcareous plates arranged in linear series.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Eight distinct transverse segments (valves) are clearly visible running from head to tail, overlapping slightly. The texture resembles calcareous material.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plates embedded in tough leathery girdle that may be smooth, spiny, or hairy.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A thick, textured band (girdle) surrounds the central plates. It appears leathery and granular, fitting the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Plate coloration ranges from grey, brown, green to mottled patterns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The plates exhibit a mottled reddish-brown and grey pattern with lighter speckling, matching natural variation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface features broad muscular foot for adhesion to rocky substrates.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is taken from a dorsal perspective. The ventral foot is completely occluded by the body against the rock.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body exhibits dorsoventrally flattened profile when clinging to surfaces.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The organism sits low against the rock surface, showing a flattened profile typical of intertidal grazers.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Can curl into defensive ball when dislodged.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: This is a behavioral capability, not a static visual feature observable in a single image of an attached specimen.

selected_experts.reason: Primary verification of species-level identity and plate morphology.
To verify the structural integrity of the eight overlapping plates and ensure they are not fused or melting into the girdle.
To detect subtle texture anomalies in the rock vs. shell differentiation and check for AI-style smoothing or noise patterns.
To ensure the chiton is physically grounded on the rock and not floating or bleeding into the background.

focus_areas: Continuity and separation of the eight dorsal valves
Texture distinction between calcareous plates and leathery girdle
Adhesion contact line between girdle and rock substrate
Absence of extra limbs or mammalian features
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Verify if the 'eight plates' are distinctly segmented or if AI generation caused them to merge. Check if the girdle texture looks biologically plausible (leathery/granular) or artificially noisy/smooth. Ensure the surrounding barnacles do not show structural fusion with the chiton.
